title: Outsourced-service coverage map
html:
Outsourced-service coverage map

Evaluate dependencies and retained responsibilities in a hosted finance system.

Required responses

options.value: Relevant hosting controls require separate evidence consideration

exhibits.title: Report scope
exhibits.html: The provider uses a carved-out hosting organization. Its report assumes user access approvals and monthly input reconciliations. The report period ends three months before the user’s year-end.

exhibits.title: User implementation
exhibits.html: The user performs access approvals but has no input reconciliation. Only a provider bridge letter is available for the remaining period.
